title: Lotus Temple
source: Retained exact building identity, one inspected exterior picture and standard viewer PMTiles/Mapzen terrain.
axis: +X east; +Y up; +Z south. Radial shell phase follows mapped roof parts. Primary stair faces the southwest garden corridor.
identityStatus: Q940843/way44827278 identifies the principal building. Standard PMTiles building35184416916110 and18 independent roof-part outlines establish the70m plan and ninefold rhythm. Nine mapped water polygons establish the pool layout. The main approach is chosen along the southwest garden corridor; the radial building has nine related entrances. Pointed shell arches face the mapped radial approach gaps; individual shell phase is picture-guided with up to20degrees uncertainty.

orientationControl.basis: Mapped roof parts establish the ninefold rhythm. The shell arches and southwest broad stair are aligned to the radial garden approach gaps. The roof-part centroid phase does not survey individual shell ridges; picture-guided phase is uncertain by up to20degrees within the repeated40-degree pattern.

reconstruction.poolLevelBasis: Each pool is fixed to its mapped outline and a neighborhood median from the unchanged standard DEM, plus12cm. These levels and visible coping/retaining edges are approximate; the coarse source cannot establish surveyed basin levels.
reconstruction.scope: Specific Lotus Temple exterior:27 curved petal shells in three ninefold groups, open porch arches, raised red/white base with continuous glazing bands, nine stepped/ramped approaches and nine independently mapped pools. Fine panel joints, exact shell engineering, hidden interiors and landscaping are omitted.
